Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Howard Duff is credited on 88 distinct recordings across 15 programs from 1942-12-15 through 1979-07-27. Documented roles include performer on 51 recordings, announcer on 25 recordings, host on 12 recordings, afrs announcer on 2 recordings, and unknown on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Adventures of Sam Spade (performer on 38 recordings; 38 distinct recordings), Duffy's Tavern (announcer on 15 recordings; 15 distinct recordings), Sears Radio Theater (host on 9 recordings and performer on 1 recording; 10 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 6 recordings, host on 2 recordings, and announcer on 1 recording; 9 distinct recordings), Encore Theater (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Molle Mystery Theatre (announcer on 1 recording and host on 1 recording; 2 distinct recordings), The Adventures of the Thin Man (afrs announcer on 2 recordings and announcer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), and The Great Gildersleeve (announcer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Sam Spade (38 portrayals) and Philip Karney (1 portrayals).
